_comment: Hand-kept copies of this repo's files in other public repos. This repo is canonical for every entry; scripts/check-copies.py compares each copy with the committed source and reports drift, it never edits. The Org_Agents workspaces' scripts/ are private and are kept in step by the Org Agents refresh job instead. Extraction-type sources (web-house-style's design system, project-hub-scaffold's references) aren't byte copies and aren't listed.
